headline: What Is Going On With PepsiCo Stock?
summary: PepsiCo (PEP) stock trades at 16.1 times earnings. The median S&P 500 company, by contrast, trades at 22.8 times earnings. Over the past year, PepsiCo shares lost 11.9%, while the S&P 500 returned 17.9%. This underperformance occurred even as the company posted higher sales, margins, and cash flow in the twelve months to September 5, 2026. The market is either overlooking an improving business, or accurately pricing a company with stalled growth. What does a buyer get at this price.

headline: Kraft Heinz vs. Monster Beverage: Which Consumer Goods Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
summary: One trades at 11x forward earnings with $4.6 billion in operating cash flow; the other is nearly debt-free with 23% net margins.
